name: Adaptive-resolution Octree TSDF Integration
definition: A volumetric SLAM pipeline that integrates and renders depth images at an adaptive level of detail. It uses a fusion algorithm to dynamically select the integration scale based on effective sensor resolution relative to distance from the scene, addressing aliasing, reconstruction quality, and efficiency.
summary: Adaptive-resolution Octree TSDF Integration is a volumetric SLAM pipeline that dynamically selects integration detail based on sensor resolution and distance to balance aliasing, quality, and efficiency.
